tools.name: appointment-intelligence_cancellation-pattern-detect
tools.description: Find cancellations, short-notice lead times, and weekday patterns from supplied timestamps. Small samples are disclosed. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/appointment-intelligence/cancellation-pattern-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: appointment-intelligence_capacity-analyze
tools.description: Compare booked appointment minutes with supplied provider capacity or slots. Overbooking is reported from those numbers only. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/appointment-intelligence/capacity-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: appointment-intelligence_schedule-utilization-calculate
tools.description: Calculate schedule and attendance utilization from supplied bookings and capacity. Recommendations describe observed fill levels only. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/appointment-intelligence/schedule-utilization-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: appointment-intelligence_booking-gap-detect
tools.description: Find gaps of at least the disclosed minute threshold between consecutive non-cancelled appointments for each provider. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/appointment-intelligence/booking-gap-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: appointment-intelligence_reminder-timing-analyze
tools.description: Compare observed no-show rates across reminder lead-time windows from supplied reminder timestamps. No reminder is sent. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/appointment-intelligence/reminder-timing-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.
